name: OmaeStrata
author: Christopher Akira
description: Monitor, start, and stop the Strata model server, with CPU/GPU usage and throughput over SSH.

barWidget.description: Strata state, CPU/GPU utilization, start/stop actions, and generation/prefill tok/s.

schema.label: Connection
schema.description: ssh talks to a remote host. local runs the collector, start script, and stop helper on this machine using STRATA_ROOT from .env.

schema.label: SSH target
schema.description: user@host reachable with SSH keys (no interactive password prompt). Ignored in local mode.

schema.label: Strata process match
schema.description: Process name substring used to detect the running Strata server.
